newsitem.title: FINLAND: Rauma signs $100 mln commercial paper.
newsitem.headline: Rauma signs $100 mln commercial paper.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Rauma Oy said in a statement on Thursday it had signed a $100 million short term euro commercial paper programme to diversify its funding.
The arranger was Enskilda Debt Capital Markets and the other dealers were Citibank International, Merita Bank, NatWest Capital Markets and Postipankki, it said.
"The program will further diversify Rauma's funding sources," the company said, adding U.S. credit rating institute Standard & Poor's has assigned an A2 rating for the programme.
